# FoundMyFitness

> > A science-based platform by Dr. Rhonda Patrick delivering evidence-backed research on longevity, nutrition, supplementation, and health optimization through podcasts, genetic analysis, and premium membership.

FoundMyFitness is a comprehensive health optimization resource featuring expert interviews, curated research digests, personalized genetic analysis, and exclusive premium content focused on nutrition science, exercise, sleep, and disease prevention. The platform combines podcast content with interactive tools and membership benefits to help users make data-driven health decisions.

## Key Topics

- Longevity
- Nutrition Science
- Brain Health
- Sleep & Recovery
- Supplements
- Exercise Benefits
- Health Optimization
- NAD Metabolism
- Omega-3 Fatty Acids
- Vitamin C
- BDNF
- Zinc
- Cardiovascular Health
- Inflammation Reduction
- Disease Prevention

## Core Platform

- [FoundMyFitness Homepage](https://www.foundmyfitness.com): Homepage for scientific health optimization platform by Dr. Rhonda Patrick
- [FoundMyFitness Episodes](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes): Podcast episodes and interviews on aging, health, nutrition, and wellness
- [Topics Directory](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/topics): Directory of health topics covering nutrition, supplements, exercise, wellness

## Premium Membership & Exclusive Content

- [FMF Premium Membership](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/crowdsponsor): Premium membership offering exclusive podcasts, Q&As, and genetic reports
- [Live Q&As with Rhonda Patrick](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/ask-me-anything): Live Q&A sessions with Dr. Rhonda Patrick for premium members
- [Science Digest Newsletter](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/science-digest): Premium newsletter curating latest health and fitness research
- [The Aliquot Podcast](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/aliquot): Members-only podcast with curated health and nutrition topic deep dives

## Personalized Tools

- [FoundMyFitness Genetics](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/genetics): Genetic analysis tool converting DNA data into personalized health insights

## Featured Episodes

- [How To Boost NAD Levels To Fight Inflammation, Improve Recovery, and Slow Aging](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/charles-brenner): Episode on NAD metabolism, supplementation, and anti-aging with Dr. Charles Brenner
- [The Best Type of Exercise for Longevity](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/exercise-intensity): Episode discussing exercise intensity and longevity research with Brady Holmer
- [Why You Can't Sleep (and How to Fix It)](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/michael-grandner): Episode on sleep science, insomnia treatment, and optimization strategies
- [How To Increase Your Testosterone Levels Naturally](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/more-plates-more-dates): Episode on natural testosterone optimization and supplementation strategies
- [This 10-Minute Exercise Reverses the Effects of Poor Sleep](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/exercise-reverses-effects-of-poor-sleep): Episode on how vigorous exercise mitigates sleep deprivation effects
- [Do These 3 Things to Eliminate Brain Fog](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/eliminate-brain-fog): Episode on brain fog elimination through meal timing, exercise, and omega-3s
